_activity: Pick the detail that proves it: 11.1
_licence: ORIGINAL, built on the shipped 11.1 casefiles. Quotes are the casefile's own text.
intro: Pick the detail that best supports the claim.

items.stem: Claim: Indentured servitude had an end date, and slavery did not. Which details best support it?

options.1: Document 10: “Loving and kind father and mother”
options.3: Document 9: “for during the space of four years” and Document 11: “a servant for life”

hints: The claim compares two things. Which choice uses two documents?
Look for a number of years and “for life.”
items.reason: One detail shows a set term and the other shows no end at all. Together they prove the difference.

items.stem: Claim: Enslaved people resisted slavery. Which detail best supports it?

options.1: Document 11: “To be sold at public auction”
options.2: Document 15: “Has been several times captured, and escaped again before he could be delivered”
options.3: Document 9: “the quantity of 50 acres of land in Virginia”
options.4: Document 13: Massachusetts becomes the first colony to legalize slavery.

hints: Which detail shows someone fighting back?
items.reason: Tom escaped again and again. The ad was written to catch him, and it proves he resisted.

items.stem: Claim: Life for indentured servants could be brutal. Which detail from Document 10 best supports it?

options.1: “for since I came out of the ship I never ate anything but peas, and loblollie”
options.3: “This is to let you understand that I your child”

items.reason: Peas and water gruel, nothing else since he got off the ship. That's the brutal detail. Lowther's contract promised the opposite.

stimulus.content:
Loving and kind father and mother,
…This is to let you understand that I your child (though at 16 years hardly a child) am in a most heavy case by reason of the country, [which] is such that it causes much sickness, such as the scurvy and the dysentery and diverse other diseases… And when we are sick there is nothing to comfort us; for since I came out of the ship I never ate anything but peas, and loblollie (that is, water gruel)…
stimulus.citation: Source: Virtual Jamestown. Richard Frethorne to his parents, 1623.
